AVCapture engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume camera capability covers storefront language. Xcode, privacy settings, and Connect actually separate capture behavior from product-page copy:

  • AVCaptureSession & camera preview — in-app code that presents the viewfinder, shutter button, and capture pipeline. Controls how users take photos or scans. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • NSCameraUsageDescription — Info.plist string shown in the system permission sheet. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains camera value to buyers.
  • VisionKit document scan & barcode detection — engineering work when your app reads documents or QR codes beyond a simple shutter. Not App Store Connect listing fields.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of camera integration.

Working in-app camera flows in the binary and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe camera and scan capture on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you implement AVCapture or VisionKit.

In-app Camera listing copy is not Photos picker, ARKit, or Files document browser

Camera-centric apps blur several surfaces indie teams conflate. AppLocale covers listing metadata only — live capture on the product page:

  • In-app Camera & scan capture (this page) — Take Photo onboarding, Camera tab screenshots, Scan/Capture overlays, QR scan marketing, document-scan gallery frames, and description copy about shooting or scanning with the device camera.
  • Photos picker & limited library (different) — Choose Photos, Select Photos, limited photo library access, Add Photos from Library. Not in-app Camera listing copy — see Photos picker listing guide.
  • ARKit / augmented reality (different) — spatial sessions, world tracking, and AR overlay marketing. Not Camera listing copy — ARKit has its own listing vocabulary and is not covered on this page.
  • Files / document browser (different) — opening PDFs, folders, and iCloud Drive documents. Not Take Photo or Scan document marketing when the story is browsing files — document-browser listing copy is a separate guide.
  • Privacy nutrition labels (different) — data-collection disclosures when camera access touches analytics. See Privacy nutrition labels listing guide — not camera viewfinder copy on utility apps.

Your screenshots may show multiple surfaces in one gallery. Listing copy should name the correct one per frame — an in-app camera viewfinder is not a Photos picker sheet, not an AR plane overlay, and not a Files document browser.

What China buyers see when zh-Hans Camera copy is missing

Camera apps often lead marketing screenshots with the viewfinder, shutter button, scan overlay, or QR capture UI — surfaces where English system chrome and your marketing blurbs appear together:

  • English title and subtitle — app name and tagline still Latin script while competitors show native Chinese camera or scan positioning
  • Untranslated camera captions — overlay lines like "Take Photo", "Camera", "Scan document", "Capture", or "Scan QR" remain English on zh-Hans gallery frames
  • Camera value in English — description opens with US marketing ("Snap a photo instantly") that China readers skim past or misread
  • Keyword field still en-US — buyers search 拍照, 扫描, 相机, or 二维码; an English-only keyword row misses China Search intent
  • Mixed page — Chinese description pasted once but screenshot captions and subtitle still English — reads unfinished next to localized competitors
  • Conflating camera with library picking — machine translation that promises 从相册选择 when your app only captures live with the camera — mismatched expectations at install

Better zh-Hans listing copy helps camera-centric buyers understand capture workflows before install. It does not replace AVCapture implementation, privacy-policy legal text, or Apple's review decisions.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need camera and scan search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 拍照, 扫描, and 相机 each signal different intent from generic productivity keywords.

Screenshot captions on camera frames

Gallery frames that show the viewfinder, shutter button, scan overlay, or QR capture UI need one-line zh-Hans captions — "一键拍照" or "扫描文档" not "Take Photo" or "Scan document" burned into the product page story.

Common mistakes on Camera-themed zh-Hans listings

  • Assuming camera integration localizes automatically — AVCapture shipped in the binary; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and Take Photo screenshot caption lines still English
  • Conflating live capture with library picking — listing says 从相册选择 when the app only shoots with the in-app camera
  • English Scan document on zh-Hans screenshots — Connect caption fields are Chinese but burned-in viewfinder labels on PNG exports are still Latin
  • Expecting AppLocale to implement AVCapture — camera session configuration and VisionKit scan code are engineering tasks outside listing rewrite scope
  • Mixing ARKit or Files vocabulary into camera copy — AR session overlays and document-browser UI belong on different listing guides, not Camera viewfinder frames
  • What's New still English after camera launch — see What's New in Simplified Chinese when scan or QR capture shipped in a recent version
